question: The mean proportional between 36 and a number N is three times the mean proportional between 8 and 32. The number N is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional = √(a × b)

⇒ √(36 × N) = 3 × √(8 × 32)

⇒ 6√N = 3 × √256 = 3 × 16 = 48

⇒ √N = 8

⇒ N = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean proportional between 36 and N is 3 times the mean proportional between 8 and 32.

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)
